name: Copper Country Comeback 2026
information:
Cubing is back in the Copper Country! This is the first competition held here in over five years, and we're thrilled to be able to bring another competition to this beautiful area.

New to competing? This competition is a good one to be your first!

Please note that this competition is in Eastern time.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association.](https://www.midwestcubing.org/)
